**1b. Distribution and floor hits.** Hill = median over post-burn-in snapshots of the pooled Hill exponent; HHI = within-market HHI (mean over markets, median over snapshots); top-10% = share of aggregate capital held by the largest 10% of units. Floor-hit rates in two definitions:
- **all-firm** (tidy `floor_hit_rate_member`, `_standalone`): floor hits of members (standalones) per firm-period over *all* firms, so the member rate rises with the share of firms in units;
- **per status** (`floor_hit_rate_*_status`): hits per firm-period *of that status*, the all-firm rate divided by the share of firms in units (standalones: by one minus it), the share taken from the post-burn-in snapshots every 100 periods. Hazard ratio = member / standalone per-status rate.

**2b. Decomposition of the consent gap K\* − K_loggain (heterogeneous)**, in members and as shares of the total:
- (a) attrition and feasibility = K\* − K_moment,hom (no transfer conflict, little estimation noise in the transfer: what remains between the moment rule and K\*);
- (b) transfer conflict = K_moment,hom − K_moment,het (the same rule, heterogeneous volatilities);
- (c) verifiability = K_moment − K_loggain, in each economy (het, the third term of the sum; hom for reference).
(a) + (b) + (c het) = total. The alternative order (a) + (c hom) + (b under loggain, K_log,hom − K_log,het) also sums to the total.
